I've finished the UI overhaul. Here's what changed:

## Design System

**Typography** — Switched from Inter to **Plus Jakarta Sans** for clearer hierarchy and a more polished feel.

**Color palette** — Dark-mode-first base (`#030712`) with a cyan → indigo → purple gradient system and semantic colors for success, warning, and error states.

**Glassmorphism** — Frosted panels with `backdrop-filter: blur(24px)`, subtle borders, inner highlights, and hover glow on cards.

## Visual Enhancements

| Area | Changes |
|------|---------|
| **Background** | Animated gradient orbs, mesh overlays, and a subtle grid pattern |
| **Header** | Brand mark with SVG icon, gradient title, pulsing connection badge |
| **Sidebar** | Glass cards with icon badges, custom select styling, shimmer progress bars |
| **Welcome screen** | Hero icon, feature pills (Adaptive · Curriculum-aware · Instant feedback) |
| **Chat** | Refined message bubbles, custom scrollbar, smoother typing animation |
| **Feedback report** | Color-coded section borders, quote-style summary, dot list markers |
| **Footer** | Minimal branded footer for hackathon polish |
| **Responsive** | Breakpoints at 1024px and 640px for tablet/mobile |

## Preserved (unchanged)

- All element **IDs** and **JS hooks** (`candidate-select`, `start-btn`, `chat-messages`, etc.)
- Full **application logic** — API calls, state management, event handlers
- Same **tech stack** — single `index.html` with internal CSS (no new frameworks)

Act as an elite frontend engineer and creative UI designer. We need to evolve our "AI Interview Agent" web app into a premium, interactive, production-ready application. Right now, the repo only contains the main dashboard screen. 

Please restructure and rewrite the frontend to implement the following requirements:

1. NEW ENTRY FLOW (LANDING PAGE):
- Create a beautiful, minimalist initial welcome page. It should feature a compelling headline (e.g., "AI-Powered Talent Evaluation at Scale"), a short tagline about the 31-Day Cohort Platform, and a highly interactive, glowing "Launch Platform" or "Enter Session" call-to-action button.

2. 3D VISUAL BACKDROP & GLASSMORPHISM:
- Replace the flat background with a deep, modern, vibrant multi-layered space layout. Use subtle geometric grid meshes or floating glowing orbs (using pure CSS/Tailwind gradients, blurs, and animation keyframes) to give an abstract 3D depth.
- Convert the UI cards ("Setup Session", "Interview Progress", Candidate Profile, "Key Strengths", "Knowledge Gaps") into premium glassmorphism elements with 'backdrop-filter: blur()', ultra-thin semi-transparent borders, and delicate outer drop-shadows to make them look like they are hovering in 3D space.

3. INTERACTIVE CORNERSTONES:
- Enhance the Candidate Profile dropdown selector with custom sleek styling, smooth open/close height animations, and clear hover/focus ring indicators.
- Turn the "Questions Asked (8/8)" progress bar into a glowing, animated loader that fills up smoothly upon page mount.
- Clean up the layout spacing, card padding, and the right-hand scroll container so it feels completely cohesive, matches the tech stack of this cloned repository, and looks incredibly polished for a competitive hackathon presentation.
-Responsiveness: Fix any awkward layouts, ensure perfect padding/margins, and make it fully mobile-responsive.
-Interactive Elements: Improve component states (hover effects, active states, and focus ring styling).
-UX Polish: Streamline the layout hierarchy so the most critical information catches the eye immediately.
Maintain all the current data logic, text placeholders (like Alex Turner's profile details), and component states exactly as they are. Let's make this stunning!

The frontend has been restructured into a two-screen flow with enhanced visuals and interactions. Here’s what changed:

## 1. Landing Page → Dashboard Flow

- **New landing screen** with headline *"AI-Powered Talent Evaluation at Scale"*, cohort tagline, stat pills (31 Days · 8 Questions · AI Feedback), and a glowing **Launch Platform** CTA.
- Clicking the button triggers a **650ms fade/scale exit** on the landing page, then the dashboard **slides up and fades in**.
- API initialization runs **after launch** so the connection badge is ready when the dashboard appears.

## 2. 3D Space & Glassmorphism

- **Multi-layer backdrop**: 4 floating orbs, perspective **grid mesh floor**, pulsing mesh rings, and deep gradient washes.
- All cards use **premium glass** — `backdrop-filter: blur(28px)`, gradient border masks, float shadows, and hover lift (`translateY(-3px)`).
- Feedback sections (Key Strengths, Knowledge Gaps, Next Steps) get the same glass treatment with color-coded top borders.

## 3. Interactive Enhancements

| Component | Enhancement |
|-----------|-------------|
| **Candidate dropdown** | Custom animated select synced to hidden native `#candidate-select` — height animation, chevron rotation, hover/focus rings, keyboard support |
| **Progress bars** | Glowing outer halo + shimmer fill; **mount animation** plays when dashboard enters |
| **Buttons & inputs** | Focus-visible rings, hover lift, disabled states |
| **Chat panel** | Tighter spacing, custom scrollbar, smoother message entrance |
| **Responsive** | Breakpoints at 1024px and 640px — sidebar grid collapses, stacked inputs on mobile |

## Preserved Logic

All interview logic is intact — same API endpoints, state variables, `#candidate-select` / `#start-btn` hooks, progress tracking, chat flow, and feedback rendering. The custom dropdown dispatches `change` events on the native select so existing handlers work unchanged.

Open `index.html` in the browser to see the landing page first, then click **Launch Platform** to enter the dashboard. If you want these changes committed and pushed, say the word.

The frontend is now a full professional multi-section website. Here's what was built:

## New Structure

```
interview-agent/
├── index.html              ← SPA shell (header, nav, 6 sections, footer)
├── assets/
│   ├── css/
│   │   ├── main.css        ← Light vibrant theme, layout, carousel, pages
│   │   └── interview.css   ← Interview dashboard styling
│   └── js/
│       ├── app.js          ← Navigation, carousel, fields, dashboard, profile
│       └── interview.js    ← All original API/interview logic preserved
└── main.py                 ← +3 lines to serve /assets (backend logic unchanged)
```

## Pages & Features

| Section | What it includes |
|---------|------------------|
| **Header** | TalentAI logo, search bar, API status badge, "Take Interview" CTA, profile avatar |
| **Nav bar** | Home · Take Interview · Results · Dashboard · Profile · Contact Us |
| **Home** | Auto-rotating hero carousel (Google/Amazon/Microsoft/Meta placements), stats bar, 6 specialization field cards |
| **Take Interview** | Full working interview UI — custom dropdown, glowing progress bars, chat, feedback |
| **Results** | Placement cards pulled from live `/api/candidates` data |
| **Dashboard** | Admin overview table with cohort metrics |
| **Profile** | Alex Turner default profile with missions, education, performance signals |
| **Contact** | Contact form + 4 branch offices (Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Delhi NCR) |
| **Footer** | 4-column layout with links, social, copyright |

## Design

- **Light & vibrant** — soft blue/lavender/mint gradients, white elevated cards
- **Professional polish** — Amazon/Stripe-style hierarchy, hover states, focus rings, responsive grid
- **Animated carousel** — 5s autoplay with dot indicators and arrow controls
- **Field selection** — pick AI/ML, Backend, Data, Full Stack, DevOps, or Prompt Engineering before interviewing

## Preserved Backend

All API endpoints (`/api/candidates`, `/api/interview`) and interview state management are unchanged. Alex Turner, Sarah Johnson, and other candidate profiles still load from your backend.

Run with `python main.py` and open `http://localhost:8000`. If you want this committed and pushed, say the word.
